style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the falcon works his whole body every beat; the pelican and the magpie move every beat they are in; the falcon's beak opens on every syllable; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; the falcon fills half the frame except the three close-up beats
character: the falcon: peregrine, moustache stripes, straw sun hat, swim ring, leash on one foot; ONE pelican boss: grey suit, tie, falconry glove on his left wing, leather hood, throat pouch; ONE magpie debt collector: leather jacket, gold chain
props: ONE coin lure: plain coins on a cord
environment: office rooftop: air conditioner, antenna, fence posts; sea below

audio.pronunciation: DU-mal, po-le-CHU v OT-pusk. o-ka-ZA-los', ya lish do-le-TA-yu ot zar-PLA-ty do zar-PLA-ty
audio.pacing: first word at 0.6; 0.6-5.8 one continuous flow, no pause between sentences; after 5.8 not a word, sfx go on

timeline.a: the falcon already mid-swoop, the leash snaps taut, swinging him into a bank, hat flapping, ring spinning; the pelican leans back, heels sliding
the falcon swings a wide loop toward camera, wings banked, swim ring bouncing; the pelican pivots on his heel, pulls out the lure; his shoulder in the foreground
the pelican flings the lure up across the lens; the falcon flips upside down on the taut leash, feet clawing after it, wings beating hard
timeline.c: medium close at the falcon's height, handheld

timeline.a: close-up: the falcon dives feet-first at the lure into the lens, talons and open beak filling the frame, coins swinging
the pelican jerks the lure away; the falcon misses, tumbles sideways, rolls back into flight
the falcon banks level right to left across the frame, wings wide, beak to camera; the leash whips round the pelican's legs, the pelican hops and spins like a top
close-up: the tangled pelican hops sideways across the lens, pouch filling the frame, coughs ONE coin; the falcon snatches it with one foot
the camera hurls itself along the leash to the glove, background rushing; the falcon slams sideways onto the glove, coin in one foot, wings windmilling; the pelican flicks off the hat, hoods him
the hooded falcon lunges sideways, nearly falls; the magpie whizzes by camera, chain swinging, claws the coin from his foot and is gone
the pelican yanks the leash; the hooded falcon flaps wildly, pecks the air, kicks his empty foot at nothing
the falcon's ring snags the antenna, bursts; the jet spins him off the glove across the frame, the limp ring flaps over the lens; the leash yanks him back
close-up: the pelican reels in, swinging the hooded falcon into the lens; his empty talons snap shut on the sun glint of the glove buckle, like a coin; hood and beak filling the frame

negative_prompt: microphone, a fourth character, slow motion, any word after 5.8, accented Russian, letters, subtitles, watermark, English speech, duplicate props, floating objects, falcon hovering in place, falcon frozen, falcon flying at the camera on his own, coin in a beak, zoom, scene change, top-down view, wide shot
